data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Every plugin is now constructed before any `onInvocationStart` hook runs. The OTel factories bind the provider, read `Span.current()`, and start the Invocation span during construction, so a preceding plugin's start hook cannot initialize the provider or install context before OTel captures it; telemetry can be disabled or parented incorrectly. Create and start plugins in one registration-order loop before publishing the completed list, or defer OTel's context-sensitive initialization to its start hook with safe publication. Update the ordering test accordingly.
